# KM45-10 Compact Joint Module

The KM45-10 is the smallest module in the KM series, built for grippers, wrists and small quadrupeds.

## Specifications

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Rated voltage | 24 V |
| Rated torque<sup>1</sup> | 1.6 N·m |
| Peak torque | 4.8 N·m |
| Rated speed | 260 rpm |
| Gear ratio | 10:1 |
| Weight | 185 g |

## Wiring

- Red: V+ (18–28 V)
- Black: GND
- Yellow: CAN H
- Green: CAN L

The module ships with CAN ID 1. Change it over the bus before you daisy-chain a second module.

<sup>1</sup> At 25 °C ambient with the housing mounted on an aluminium plate.
